contexts.text: All (such)... hurry into vaults (or subterranean places) which, at their entrances, appear very dark.
These, too, are in vaults, and enter chambers cameras-so dark, that they cannot see one another.
The ecclesiastics hid (the treasures) in the cells and subterranean vaults of that city.
When they feel anything from conjugial love, they flee into subterranean places...
At the mere perception of Divine truth, infernal Genii... creep into subterranean places, to hide themselves.
What is signified by caves, caverns, vaults, holes, etc. Explained.
